newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady to firmer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady to firmer in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady to firmer on Tuesday but trade was thin with good ARA supplies and flat U.S. gasoline markets capping gains, traders said.
Eurograde summer spec barges were traded at $211.50 and $212 a tonne fob ARA, around $1 firmer on the day, with the winter/summer spec spread done at +$2 a tonne.
Swaps steadied in late business after losing around $1.50 a tonne in the morning extending Monday's $4 a tonne losses.
April swaps traded at $208.75 up to $209.50 with May talking about 50 cents to $1 lower.
Q2 crack spreads held at $5.35 little changed from Monday.
In the key U.S. market traders said the seasonal gasoline rally is still under way with year-on-year inventory shortfalls and rising open interest both supporting the advance.

But despite U.S. gasoline's relative strength, price gains have been stalled by refiner selling of cracks at attractive levels and receding fears of a strike by workers at Unocal's four California refineries.
